tuning: No tuning. Every threshold below was fixed before any measurement ran.
question: Does a proved forced run pay for itself as a search bound, and where?

modes.leaf: certificate_enabled against no certificate at all; the cost of the existing use.
modes.cutoff: certificate_cutoff_enabled against the leaf certificate alone.
modes.guard: certificate_guard_enabled against the same selective search without it. PVS stays on, since narrow windows are what make null-move and futility reachable.
modes.race: race_reduction_enabled against LMR alone. PVS is off, because LMR is only consulted where PVS is not already probing a child.

oracle.method: Full-width alpha-beta to the claimed distance with the certificate off. Alpha-beta returns the true minimax value at a fixed depth, so a mate-range score confirms the claim and anything else refutes it.

acceptance.trigger: A cutoff_min_depth is only recommended if it reduces work, not merely nodes. Probes are charged, so a setting that saves nodes while spending more work has not paid.
acceptance.unfinished: Excluded from the win-rate denominator; never an official draw.

method: Every option is measured against the same search with that option removed and nothing else changed. There is no cross-option comparison: the arms of different pairs do not share an engine.

extended.why: The predeclared run left the oracle with three checks and 24 of 32 paired games unfinished, so neither section could answer its question. These overrides add power to the same comparison; they do not change what is compared, and the predeclared run is published alongside rather than replaced.
extended.declared_after: the predeclared run, before the extended run
